items.question: Trong câu "The agile mindset is not a set of ceremonies.", từ "mindset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The agile mindset is not a set of ceremonies.", what does "mindset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (danh từ): tư duy, lối suy nghĩ. "Growth mindset" = tư duy phát triển; "agile mindset" = cách nghĩ theo tinh thần agile.
items.explanationEn: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (noun): a way of thinking. "Growth mindset" and "agile mindset" describe ways of thinking.

items.question: Trong câu "The agile mindset is not a set of ceremonies.", từ "ceremony" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The agile mindset is not a set of ceremonies.", what does "ceremony" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (danh từ): nghi thức họp định kỳ. Trong Scrum, sprint planning, daily scrum, review, retro được gọi là "ceremonies".
items.explanationEn: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (noun): a fixed routine meeting. In Scrum, planning, daily scrum, review and retro are called "ceremonies".

items.question: Trong câu "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", từ "continuous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", what does "continuous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (tính từ): liên tục, không ngắt quãng. "Continuous delivery/improvement" = bàn giao/cải tiến liên tục.
items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (adjective): going on without stopping. "Continuous delivery/improvement" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", từ "representative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", what does "representative" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person acting for a group
items.explanation: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.tə.tɪv/ (danh từ): người đại diện. Động từ: represent; "sales representative" = nhân viên kinh doanh.
items.explanationEn: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.tə.tɪv/ (noun): a person acting for a group. Verb: represent; a "sales representative" sells for a company.

items.question: Trong câu "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", từ "kickoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuous collaboration between technical, business and customer representatives — not collaboration once at kickoff and never again.", what does "kickoff" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the start meeting of a project
items.explanation: kickoff /ˈkɪk.ɒf/ (danh từ): buổi khởi động dự án. "Kickoff meeting" = cuộc họp khởi động; nghĩa gốc từ bóng đá.
items.explanationEn: kickoff /ˈkɪk.ɒf/ (noun): the start meeting of a project. "Kickoff meeting" starts a project; the word comes from football.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting user feedback as often as possible — feedback is a source of information, not an acceptance formality.", từ "formality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting user feedback as often as possible — feedback is a source of information, not an acceptance formality.", what does "formality" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a step done only for form
items.explanation: formality /fɔːˈmæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thủ tục hình thức. "Just a formality" = chỉ là thủ tục cho có.
items.explanationEn: formality /fɔːˈmæl.ə.ti/ (noun): a step done only for form. "Just a formality" means a step with no real effect.

items.question: Trong câu "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", từ "increment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", what does "increment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a small added piece of product
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (danh từ): phần sản phẩm bổ sung. Tính từ: incremental; "incremental delivery" = bàn giao từng phần.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (noun): a small added piece of product. Adjective: incremental; "incremental delivery" means delivering piece by piece.

items.question: Trong câu "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành sản phẩm. Khẩu ngữ ngành phần mềm: "ship a feature" = phát hành tính năng cho người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product. Software slang: "ship a feature" means release it to users.

items.question: Trong câu "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", từ "come back to bite" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delivering small, high-quality increments frequently — small so you learn fast, high quality so what you shipped does not come back to bite you.", what does "come back to bite" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come back to bite /kʌm bæk tə baɪt/ (cụm từ): gây hậu quả về sau. Thành ngữ: quyết định ẩu hôm nay sẽ "come back to bite you" (quay lại làm hại bạn).
items.explanationEn: come back to bite /kʌm bæk tə baɪt/ (phrase): to cause problems later. An idiom: a careless choice today will "come back to bite you".

items.question: Trong câu "And here is the behaviour that is not part of the agile mindset, however common it is:", từ "however" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "And here is the behaviour that is not part of the agile mindset, however common it is:", what does "however" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: however /haʊˈev.ər/ (trạng từ): dù ... đến đâu. "However + tính từ" = dù ... thế nào; khi đứng đầu câu thì nghĩa là "tuy nhiên".
items.explanationEn: however /haʊˈev.ər/ (adverb): no matter how. "However + adjective" means no matter how; at the start of a sentence it means "but".

items.question: Trong câu "Detailing everything up front and then handing off is precisely the model the Agile Extension to the BABOK Guide was written against.", từ "detail" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailing everything up front and then handing off is precisely the model the Agile Extension to the BABOK Guide was written against.", what does "detail" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: detail /ˈdiː.teɪl/ (động từ): mô tả chi tiết. Là động từ, "detail X" = trình bày X cặn kẽ; "in detail" = một cách chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: detail /ˈdiː.teɪl/ (verb): to describe fully. As a verb, "detail X" means describe X fully; "in detail" means thoroughly.

items.question: Trong câu "Detailing everything up front and then handing off is precisely the model the Agile Extension to the BABOK Guide was written against.", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailing everything up front and then handing off is precisely the model the Agile Extension to the BABOK Guide was written against.", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Big design up front" = thiết kế hết từ đầu; "pay up front" = trả tiền trước.
items.explanationEn: up front /ˌʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the beginning, in advance. "Big design up front" plans everything first; "pay up front" means pay in advance.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not wrong because documentation is bad — it is wrong because it assumes you know everything at the moment you know the least.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not wrong because documentation is bad — it is wrong because it assumes you know everything at the moment you know the least.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định, cho rằng. "Assume that…" = cho rằng; "assume a role" = đảm nhận vai trò.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to believe without proof. "Assume that…" means suppose; "assume a role" means take it on.

items.question: Trong câu "For a BA, the four translate into daily work like this:", từ "translate into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a BA, the four translate into daily work like this:", what does "translate into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: translate into /trænzˈleɪt ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): chuyển thành, thể hiện ra. "Translate into action/results" = biến thành hành động/kết quả.
items.explanationEn: translate into /trænzˈleɪt ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to become in practice. "Translate into action/results" means turn into them.

items.question: Trong câu "Individuals and interactions — you go and talk to users instead of mailing out a requirements form; you put people at the centre of the solution.", từ "mail out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Individuals and interactions — you go and talk to users instead of mailing out a requirements form; you put people at the centre of the solution.", what does "mail out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mail out /ˌmeɪl ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): gửi đi hàng loạt. Danh từ: mailout; ở đây ý là gửi biểu mẫu thay vì trò chuyện trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: mail out /ˌmeɪl ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to send to many people. Noun: mailout; here it means sending forms instead of talking.

items.question: Trong câu "Working software — you arrange a 20-minute demo instead of writing a 30-page specification to get the same answer.", từ "arrange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Working software — you arrange a 20-minute demo instead of writing a 30-page specification to get the same answer.", what does "arrange" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (động từ): tổ chức, sắp xếp. "Arrange a meeting/demo" = sắp xếp buổi họp/demo; danh từ: arrangement.
items.explanationEn: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (verb): to plan and organise. "Arrange a meeting/demo"; noun: arrangement.

items.question: Trong câu "Customer collaboration — you sit with the customer to understand the feedback rather than citing the signed scope.", từ "cite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Customer collaboration — you sit with the customer to understand the feedback rather than citing the signed scope.", what does "cite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cite /saɪt/ (động từ): viện dẫn. "Cite the contract/source" = viện dẫn hợp đồng/nguồn; danh từ: citation.
items.explanationEn: cite /saɪt/ (verb): to refer to as support. "Cite the contract/source" means refer to it; noun: citation.

items.question: Trong câu "Responding to change — you reorder the backlog when usage data says the original assumption was wrong.", từ "reorder" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Responding to change — you reorder the backlog when usage data says the original assumption was wrong.", what does "reorder" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reorder /riˈɔː.dər/ (động từ): sắp xếp lại thứ tự. "Reorder the backlog" = đổi thứ tự ưu tiên; nghĩa khác: đặt hàng lại.
items.explanationEn: reorder /riˈɔː.dər/ (verb): to change the order of. "Reorder the backlog" changes priorities; it can also mean buy again.

items.question: Trong câu "Responding to change — you reorder the backlog when usage data says the original assumption was wrong.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Responding to change — you reorder the backlog when usage data says the original assumption was wrong.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Validate an assumption" = kiểm chứng giả định; BA nên ghi lại các assumption.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something believed without proof. "Validate an assumption" means test it; BAs should log assumptions.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not say documentation is useless, or that planning is pointless.", từ "pointless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not say documentation is useless, or that planning is pointless.", what does "pointless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pointless /ˈpɔɪnt.ləs/ (tính từ): vô nghĩa, vô ích. Đồng nghĩa: useless, meaningless; "it's pointless to…" = làm… cũng vô ích.
items.explanationEn: pointless /ˈpɔɪnt.ləs/ (adjective): having no purpose. Synonyms: useless, meaningless; "it's pointless to…" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "It says: when the two sides conflict and you must choose, the left-hand item wins.", từ "conflict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It says: when the two sides conflict and you must choose, the left-hand item wins.", what does "conflict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. Động từ nhấn âm 2 /kənˈflɪkt/, danh từ nhấn âm 1 /ˈkɒn.flɪkt/.
items.explanationEn: conflict /kənˈflɪkt/ (verb): to be incompatible. The verb stresses the second syllable; the noun stresses the first.

items.question: Trong câu "There is a very practical consequence when you sit an assessment:", từ "sit an assessment" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is a very practical consequence when you sit an assessment:", what does "sit an assessment" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: sit an assessment /sɪt ən əˈses.mənt/ (cụm từ): dự một bài thi. Tiếng Anh-Anh: "sit an exam" = đi thi; Anh-Mỹ hay nói "take an exam".
items.explanationEn: sit an assessment /sɪt ən əˈses.mənt/ (phrase): to take a test. British English says "sit an exam"; American English says "take an exam".

items.question: Trong câu "There is a very practical consequence when you sit an assessment:", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is a very practical consequence when you sit an assessment:", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả. "As a consequence" = do đó; "face the consequences" = chịu hậu quả.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result that follows. "As a consequence" means as a result; "face the consequences" means accept the results.

items.question: Trong câu "Gathering or discussing feedback with the customer", từ "gather" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gathering or discussing feedback with the customer", what does "gather" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (động từ): thu thập. "Gather requirements/feedback" = thu thập yêu cầu/phản hồi; nghĩa khác: tụ họp.
items.explanationEn: gather /ˈɡæð.ər/ (verb): to collect together. "Gather requirements/feedback" means collect them; it can also mean people coming together.

items.question: Trong câu "The question is never "do we document" but "how much is enough for the team to understand and for a decision to be made".", từ "document" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The question is never "do we document" but "how much is enough for the team to understand and for a decision to be made".", what does "document" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: document /ˈdɒk.jə.ment/ (động từ): ghi thành tài liệu. Động từ phát âm /ˈdɒk.jə.ment/; "well-documented" = có tài liệu đầy đủ.
items.explanationEn: document /ˈdɒk.jə.ment/ (verb): to record in writing. The verb is pronounced /ˈdɒk.jə.ment/; "well-documented" means fully recorded.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the single most important discriminator in this topic.", từ "discriminator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the single most important discriminator in this topic.", what does "discriminator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a feature that tells things apart
a person who treats others unfairly
items.explanation: discriminator /dɪˈskrɪm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (danh từ): yếu tố phân biệt. Động từ: discriminate between A and B = phân biệt A và B.
items.explanationEn: discriminator /dɪˈskrɪm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (noun): a feature that tells things apart. Verb: discriminate between A and B means tell them apart.

items.question: Trong câu "When you read a scenario, do not ask "what is this about"", từ "scenario" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you read a scenario, do not ask "what is this about"", what does "scenario" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scenario /sɪˈnɑː.ri.əʊ/ (danh từ): tình huống. "Scenario-based question" = câu hỏi dựa trên tình huống; "worst-case scenario" = tình huống xấu nhất.
items.explanationEn: scenario /sɪˈnɑː.ri.əʊ/ (noun): a described situation. "Scenario-based question"; "worst-case scenario" is the worst possible case.

items.question: Trong câu "The emphasis is the relationship and the joint conversation", từ "emphasis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The emphasis is the relationship and the joint conversation", what does "emphasis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: emphasis /ˈem.fə.sɪs/ (danh từ): trọng tâm nhấn mạnh. Động từ: emphasise; "put emphasis on X" = nhấn mạnh X.
items.explanationEn: emphasis /ˈem.fə.sɪs/ (noun): special importance given. Verb: emphasise; "put emphasis on X" means stress X.

items.question: Trong câu "The emphasis is the relationship and the joint conversation", từ "joint" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The emphasis is the relationship and the joint conversation", what does "joint" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: joint /dʒɔɪnt/ (tính từ): chung, cùng nhau. "Joint venture" = liên doanh; là danh từ "joint" = khớp xương.
items.explanationEn: joint /dʒɔɪnt/ (adjective): shared by two or more. "Joint venture" is a shared business; as a noun "joint" is a body joint.

items.question: Trong câu "Acting on feedback — adding, removing, reordering the backlog", từ "act on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Acting on feedback — adding, removing, reordering the backlog", what does "act on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: act on /ˈækt ɒn/ (cụm từ): hành động dựa trên. "Act on advice/feedback" = làm theo lời khuyên/phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: act on /ˈækt ɒn/ (phrase): to take action because of. "Act on advice/feedback" means do something because of it.

items.question: Trong câu "The emphasis is that the working increment is the better feedback instrument", từ "instrument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The emphasis is that the working increment is the better feedback instrument", what does "instrument" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (danh từ): công cụ, phương tiện. "An instrument for change" = công cụ tạo thay đổi; nghĩa khác: nhạc cụ.
items.explanationEn: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (noun): a tool for doing something. "An instrument for change" is a means of change; also a musical device.

items.question: Trong câu "Putting people at the centre; working closely with stakeholders along the whole value chain", từ "value chain" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Putting people at the centre; working closely with stakeholders along the whole value chain", what does "value chain" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: steps that create value for customers
items.explanation: value chain /ˈvæl.juː ˌtʃeɪn/ (cụm từ): chuỗi giá trị. Khái niệm kinh doanh của Michael Porter: các hoạt động nối tiếp tạo ra giá trị.
items.explanationEn: value chain /ˈvæl.juː ˌtʃeɪn/ (phrase): steps that create value for customers. A business concept: the linked activities that create value.

items.question: Trong câu "The emphasis is human interaction rather than an artefact or a process", từ "artefact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The emphasis is human interaction rather than an artefact or a process", what does "artefact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: artefact /ˈɑː.tɪ.fækt/ (danh từ): sản phẩm tài liệu. Cách viết Mỹ: artifact; trong Scrum, backlog và increment là "artifacts".
items.explanationEn: artefact /ˈɑː.tɪ.fækt/ (noun): a document or model produced. American spelling: artifact; in Scrum the backlog and increment are artifacts.

items.question: Trong câu "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", từ "subtle" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", what does "subtle" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: subtle /ˈsʌt.əl/ (tính từ): tinh tế, khó nhận ra. Chữ "b" câm; "a subtle difference" = khác biệt tinh tế.
items.explanationEn: subtle /ˈsʌt.əl/ (adjective): not obvious. The "b" is silent; "a subtle difference" is hard to notice.

items.question: Trong câu "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", từ "defensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", what does "defensible" (adjective) mean?
options: có lý lẽ bảo vệ được
items.explanation: defensible /dɪˈfen.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): có lý lẽ bảo vệ được. Động từ: defend; "a defensible decision" = quyết định có thể biện hộ.
items.explanationEn: defensible /dɪˈfen.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be justified. Verb: defend; "a defensible decision" can be justified.

items.question: Trong câu "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", từ "in isolation" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note something subtle: in a well-written question all four options are defensible in isolation.", what does "in isolation" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in isolation /ɪn ˌaɪ.səˈleɪ.ʃən/ (cụm từ): khi xét riêng lẻ. "Viewed in isolation" = xem xét tách biệt, không so với cái khác.
items.explanationEn: in isolation /ɪn ˌaɪ.səˈleɪ.ʃən/ (phrase): considered separately. "Viewed in isolation" means without comparing to others.

items.question: Trong câu "The assessment does not ask "which option is correct" but "which is most strongly evident".", từ "evident" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The assessment does not ask "which option is correct" but "which is most strongly evident".", what does "evident" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: evident /ˈev.ɪ.dənt/ (tính từ): thể hiện rõ. Danh từ: evidence (bằng chứng); "it is evident that…" = rõ ràng là…
items.explanationEn: evident /ˈev.ɪ.dənt/ (adjective): clearly seen. Noun: evidence; "it is evident that…" means clearly…

items.question: Trong câu "The recurring phrasing in the official explanations is:", từ "recurring" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recurring phrasing in the official explanations is:", what does "recurring" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recurring /rɪˈkɜː.rɪŋ/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Recurring payment" = thanh toán định kỳ; động từ: recur.
items.explanationEn: recurring /rɪˈkɜː.rɪŋ/ (adjective): happening again and again. "Recurring payment" repeats regularly; verb: recur.

items.question: Trong câu "The recurring phrasing in the official explanations is:", từ "phrasing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recurring phrasing in the official explanations is:", what does "phrasing" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the words chosen to say something
items.explanation: phrasing /ˈfreɪ.zɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách diễn đạt. Động từ: phrase ("phrase a question carefully" = diễn đạt câu hỏi cẩn thận).
items.explanationEn: phrasing /ˈfreɪ.zɪŋ/ (noun): the words chosen to say something. Verb: phrase ("phrase a question carefully").

items.question: Trong câu "These two values both concern customer feedback, which is why they get swapped most often.", từ "concern" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These two values both concern customer feedback, which is why they get swapped most often.", what does "concern" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (động từ): liên quan đến. "Concern X" = nói về X; "be concerned about" = lo lắng về.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (verb): to be about. "Concern X" means be about X; "be concerned about" means worry.

items.question: Trong câu "These two values both concern customer feedback, which is why they get swapped most often.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These two values both concern customer feedback, which is why they get swapped most often.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): tráo đổi cho nhau. "Swap A for B" = đổi A lấy B; "get swapped" = bị nhầm/tráo lẫn.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange one for another. "Swap A for B" means exchange them; "get swapped" means mixed up.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA and Product Owner take the feedback into the backlog, adding items, removing items, reordering priorities → Responding to change.", từ "priority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA and Product Owner take the feedback into the backlog, adding items, removing items, reordering priorities → Responding to change.", what does "priority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thứ tự ưu tiên. Động từ: prioritise; "top priority" = ưu tiên hàng đầu.
items.explanationEn: priority /praɪˈɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): importance relative to others. Verb: prioritise; "top priority" means most important.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA and Product Owner take the feedback into the backlog, adding items, removing items, reordering priorities → Responding to change.", từ "backlog" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA and Product Owner take the feedback into the backlog, adding items, removing items, reordering priorities → Responding to change.", what does "backlog" (noun) mean?
options: danh sách hạng mục cần làm
optionsEn: an ordered list of work items
items.explanation: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): danh sách hạng mục cần làm. Trong agile, "product backlog" là danh sách ưu tiên; nghĩa chung là việc tồn đọng.
items.explanationEn: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (noun): an ordered list of work items. In agile the "product backlog" is a ranked list; generally it means work piled up.

items.question: Trong câu "A second pair also gets confused:", từ "confused" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A second pair also gets confused:", what does "confused" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (tính từ): bị nhầm lẫn. "Confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B; "get confused" = bị lẫn lộn.
items.explanationEn: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (adjective): mistaken for something else. "Confuse A with B" means mix them up; "get confused" is the passive form.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", từ "persuade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", what does "persuade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (động từ): thuyết phục. "Persuade someone to do X / that…" = thuyết phục ai; danh từ: persuasion.
items.explanationEn: persuade /pəˈsweɪd/ (verb): to make someone agree. "Persuade someone to do X / that…"; noun: persuasion.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): mang lại, tạo ra. "Yield results" = mang lại kết quả; biển "Yield" = nhường đường.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce a result. "Yield results" means produce them; a "Yield" sign means give way.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA persuades a stakeholder that a demo will yield better feedback than a detailed document, there genuinely is human interaction", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (trạng từ): thực sự. Tính từ: genuine; "genuinely interested" = thực lòng quan tâm.
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (adverb): truly, really. Adjective: genuine; "genuinely interested" means truly interested.

items.question: Trong câu "Try these four before you attempt the questions.", từ "attempt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Try these four before you attempt the questions.", what does "attempt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attempt /əˈtempt/ (động từ): thử làm. Trang trọng hơn "try"; danh từ: "first attempt" = lần thử đầu tiên.
items.explanationEn: attempt /əˈtempt/ (verb): to try to do. More formal than "try"; noun: "first attempt".

items.question: Trong câu "Cover the right-hand column.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cover the right-hand column.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put something over to hide
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): che lại. Ở đây nghĩa đen: che cột đáp án; nghĩa khác: "cover for someone" = làm thay ai.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to put something over to hide. Literal here: hide the answer column; "cover for someone" means stand in.

items.question: Trong câu "Amy works with decision makers each iteration to remove things, add things and update the order of importance of the backlog", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amy works with decision makers each iteration to remove things, add things and update the order of importance of the backlog", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): vòng phát triển. Tính từ: iterative; trong Scrum một iteration gọi là sprint.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): one repeated work cycle. Adjective: iterative; in Scrum an iteration is a sprint.

items.question: Trong câu "Amy works with decision makers each iteration to remove things, add things and update the order of importance of the backlog", từ "decision maker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Amy works with decision makers each iteration to remove things, add things and update the order of importance of the backlog", what does "decision maker" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person with power to decide
items.explanation: decision maker /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kər/ (danh từ): người ra quyết định. "Key decision makers" = những người có quyền quyết định chính.
items.explanationEn: decision maker /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kər/ (noun): a person with power to decide. "Key decision makers" hold the main authority.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", từ "seek" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", what does "seek" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: seek /siːk/ (động từ): tìm kiếm, chủ động xin. Bất quy tắc: seek–sought–sought; "seek advice/feedback" = xin lời khuyên/phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: seek /siːk/ (verb): to try to get. Irregular: seek–sought–sought; "seek advice/feedback".

items.question: Trong câu "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", từ "ongoing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", what does "ongoing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ongoing /ˈɒnˌɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): liên tục, đang diễn ra. "Ongoing project/support" = dự án/hỗ trợ đang tiếp diễn.
items.explanationEn: ongoing /ˈɒnˌɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): continuing over time. "Ongoing project/support" is still continuing.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", từ "satisfy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA seeks ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders to learn how well the solution is satisfying their needs", what does "satisfy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (động từ): đáp ứng. "Satisfy needs/requirements" = đáp ứng nhu cầu/yêu cầu; danh từ: satisfaction.
items.explanationEn: satisfy /ˈsæt.ɪs.faɪ/ (verb): to meet a need. "Satisfy needs/requirements"; noun: satisfaction.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile mindset = continuous collaboration + frequent feedback + small, high-quality increments.", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile mindset = continuous collaboration + frequent feedback + small, high-quality increments.", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cộng tác. Động từ: collaborate with; "customer collaboration" là một giá trị agile.
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together. Verb: collaborate with; "customer collaboration" is an agile value.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile mindset = continuous collaboration + frequent feedback + small, high-quality increments.", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile mindset = continuous collaboration + frequent feedback + small, high-quality increments.", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường xuyên. Trạng từ: frequently; danh từ: frequency (tần suất).
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. Adverb: frequently; noun: frequency.

items.question: Trong câu "The word "over" keeps the right-hand items valuable.", từ "valuable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The word "over" keeps the right-hand items valuable.", what does "valuable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valuable /ˈvæl.ju.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có giá trị. "Valuable feedback/insight" = phản hồi/góc nhìn quý giá.
items.explanationEn: valuable /ˈvæl.ju.ə.bəl/ (adjective): worth a lot. "Valuable feedback/insight" is very useful.

items.question: Trong câu "Any option calling documentation or planning worthless is wrong.", từ "worthless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Any option calling documentation or planning worthless is wrong.", what does "worthless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (tính từ): vô giá trị. Hậu tố "-less" = không có: worthless, pointless, useless.
items.explanationEn: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (adjective): having no value. The suffix "-less" means without: worthless, pointless, useless.

items.question: Trong câu "All four options are plausible; you pick the most evident one, not the only true one.", từ "plausible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All four options are plausible; you pick the most evident one, not the only true one.", what does "plausible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): nghe có vẻ hợp lý. "A plausible explanation" = lời giải thích nghe hợp lý (chưa chắc đúng).
items.explanationEn: plausible /ˈplɔː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): seeming reasonable. "A plausible explanation" sounds reasonable but may not be true.

items.question: Trong câu "Completing and approving all requirements before hand-off is not part of it.", từ "hand-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Completing and approving all requirements before hand-off is not part of it.", what does "hand-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hand-off /ˈhænd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự bàn giao. Còn viết "handoff"; "hand off to the development team" = bàn giao cho đội phát triển.
items.explanationEn: hand-off /ˈhænd.ɒf/ (noun): passing work to another team. Also "handoff"; "hand off to the development team" is the verb form.

items.question: Trong câu "Completing and approving all requirements before hand-off is not part of it.", từ "approve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Completing and approving all requirements before hand-off is not part of it.", what does "approve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approve /əˈpruːv/ (động từ): phê duyệt. Danh từ: approval; "sign-off" là cách nói khác cho phê duyệt chính thức.
items.explanationEn: approve /əˈpruːv/ (verb): to officially accept. Noun: approval; "sign-off" is another word for formal approval.
